rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold a six-Justice coalition by writing a measured opinion grounding the result in APA § 706’s text and shifting from Chevron to independent judicial judgment with Skidmore-style respect. Gorsuch and Thomas are the most likely to write separately to press broader separation-of-powers/originalist critiques, while Kagan is the most likely dissenter to defend a Mead/Kisor-cabined Chevron framework and reliance interests.
